analysis.reasonEn: The upward trend has been maintained for 3 consecutive sessions following the previous buy signal (RSI 48.6, MACD improvement). The current price of $576.14 is above the SMA20 at $573.10 and has settled at the middle Bollinger Band. RSI at 48.6 has exited oversold territory and is consolidating in the neutral zone. The MACD histogram has improved from -4.2147 to 0.1573, signaling an imminent golden cross. The volume ratio of 2.32 compared to the 5-day average adds conviction to the upward movement. The 52-week position at 20.7% shows a recovery from the lows.
